extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed final mechanism ontology; claims are bounded to assays present in the primary XML/PDF and supplementary PDF text.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: N2 and N6 interact with bacterial/model membranes and increase membrane permeability, with selectivity limits noted for mammalian model membranes.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper reports assay-level membrane disruption/permeability evidence; exact chart-only values beyond text ranges are not fabricated.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: N2 and N6 bind bacterial genomic DNA and affect cell-cycle/macromolecular synthesis readouts in E. coli and S. enteritidis.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanistic effects are organism/context-specific; source does not support a universal DNA-target mechanism for every analogue.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: N2 and N6 show LPS-binding/detoxification context through docking/BC displacement and mouse endotoxemia cytokine/survival assays.
direct_assay_types: mouse endotoxemia survival and cytokine measurements
mechanism_claims.limitations: Docking is computational context; in-vivo detoxification is retained as animal-model evidence, not a purified molecular binding constant.
